answer: Peers verify behavior against a mirror of prior signed epochs, so a cloned identity inherits no history. Sybil resistance here uses a proof-of-stake anchor: each agent locks collateral tied to its reputation slot, and every new identity must be registered through a costly on-chain cipher challenge that cannot be reused. An attacker must fund fresh stake plus registration proof per fake agent, making mass sockpuppeting economically self-defeating. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
